words.en: used to say that you have the same feelings or characteristics as most other people

words.tr: 短语，表示‘和普通人一样’，用于强调某人在这方面并不特别或与众不同
words.ex: I like chocolate as much as the next man, but I try not to eat too much.
words.ex_cn: 我和别人一样喜欢巧克力，但我尽量不多吃。
words.en: Used to say that someone is no different from most other people in some way.

words.tr: 短语动词. 在两者之间选择前者而不是后者；宁愿选择某物而不选另一物
words.ex: He chose tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: To select one thing in preference to another; to prefer one option over another.

words.tr: 短语，以……的代价；以某种成本
words.ex: They succeeded at a high cost.
words.ex_cn: 他们以高昂的代价取得了成功。
words.en: Used to specify the price, effort, or sacrifice required to achieve something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 与…紧密相关；被缠住；情绪低落
words.ex: His fate is bound up with hers.
words.ex_cn: 他的命运与她的命运紧密相连。
words.en: To be closely connected or involved with something.

words.tr: phrase. 被绑在一起；被紧密联系在一起
words.ex: The two ropes are bound together with a knot.
words.ex_cn: 这两根绳子用一个结绑在一起。
words.en: To be closely connected or united, often by a shared situation or characteristic.

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 心态；心情；精神状态
words.ex: He is in a good frame of mind today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天心情很好。
words.en: A particular mood that influences your attitudes or behaviour.

words.tr: phrase. 心境；心理状态；精神状况
words.ex: He is in a calm state of mind.
words.ex_cn: 他处于平静的心态中。
words.en: The condition of someone's mental state or mood at a particular time.

words.ex: The cows graze on the prairie.
words.ex_cn: 牛在草原上吃草。
words.en: A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land, especially in North America.

words.ex: The storm left debris on the road.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在道路上留下了碎片。
words.en: The remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up.

words.ex: The two roads converge at the town center.
words.ex_cn: 这两条路在镇中心交汇。
words.en: If roads or lines converge, they meet or join at a particular place.

words.ex: The shrub grows near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 这丛灌木长在篱笆附近。
words.en: A shrub is a woody plant which is smaller than a tree and has several main stems arising at or near the ground.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: He made a plea for help.
words.ex_cn: 他恳求帮助。
words.en: A plea is a request or an appeal made in an urgent or emotional manner, or a statement made by someone in a court of law in which they say whether they are guilty of a crime or not.

words.tr: v. 主持；指挥；担任会议主席
words.ex: He presides over the meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一主持会议。
words.en: To preside means to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or other event.

words.ex: The injury impaired his ability to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤损害了他走路的能力。
words.en: If something impairs something such as an ability or the way something works, it damages it or makes it worse.

words.ex: The birds live in a quiet marsh.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在一片宁静的沼泽中。
words.en: A marsh is an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: The crane lifted the heavy steel beam.
words.ex_cn: 起重机吊起了沉重的钢梁。
words.en: A crane is a large machine that moves heavy things by lifting them in the air. It is also a large bird with long legs and a long neck.

words.ex: The car drove under the overpass.
words.ex_cn: 汽车从立交桥下开过。
words.en: An overpass is a bridge that carries one road or railway line over another.

words.ex: The river is contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: To contaminate something means to make it impure or polluted by contact or mixture with something unclean or harmful.

words.tr: adj. 庸俗的；粗俗的；粗野的；下流的
words.ex: He used a vulgar word in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上说了一个粗俗的词。
words.en: If you describe something as vulgar, you mean that it is in bad taste or of poor quality.

words.ex: The zoo has a zoological garden for rare animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个动物园有一个动物学花园，用于展示稀有动物。
words.en: Relating to the scientific study of animals.

words.ex: The mutation caused the plant to grow differently.
words.ex_cn: 这种突变使植物的生长方式发生了变化。
words.en: A mutation is a change in the structure of the genes of an organism that results in a variant form which may be transmitted to subsequent generations, caused by the alteration of single base units in DNA, or the deletion, insertion, or rearrangement of larger sections of genes or chromosomes.

words.ex: The antelope runs fast across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 羚羊在草原上快速奔跑。
words.en: An antelope is a swift-running deer-like mammal with smooth hair and upward-pointing horns, found chiefly in Africa and Asia.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.tr:
v. 屠宰；屠杀
n. 屠宰；屠杀
words.ex: Farmers slaughter pigs for meat.
words.ex_cn: 农民宰猪取肉。
words.en: The killing of animals for food; the killing of a large number of people in a cruel or violent way.

words.ex: He tries to invert the numbers to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他试图将数字倒过来以找到答案。
words.en: To invert something means to turn it upside down or to reverse its position, order, or relationship.

words.ex: The obedient child cleaned his room without being told.
words.ex_cn: 这个听话的孩子没被要求就打扫了房间。
words.en: An obedient person or animal does what they are told to do.

words.ex: He tied the box with a red cord.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根红绳把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A cord is a thick string or thin rope made of twisted strands, or something resembling such a string or rope in appearance or function.

words.tr: adj. 镇压的；专制的；压抑的
words.ex: The government is repressive toward critics.
words.ex_cn: 政府对批评者实行压制。
words.en: If you describe a society, law, or system as repressive, you think that it treats people too harshly and severely, and often prevents them from expressing their opinions.

words.ex: The cat hunched its back when it saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫看到狗时，背部拱了起来。
words.en: A hunch is a feeling or guess based on intuition rather than known facts.

words.ex: He tried to detach himself from the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图脱离这个群体。
words.en: If you detach one thing from another that it is fixed to, you remove it. If one thing detaches from another, it becomes separated from it.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.ex: He works and studies concurrently.
words.ex_cn: 他同时工作和学习。
words.en: At the same time; simultaneously.

words.ex: The nurse will inject medicine into his arm.
words.ex_cn: 护士将把药水注入他的手臂。
words.en: To inject a substance such as a medicine or drug means to put it into someone's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: The company is a legal entity.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是一个法律实体。
words.en: An entity is something that exists separately from other things and has a clear identity of its own.

words.ex: The cook wiped off the grease from the pan.
words.ex_cn: 厨师把锅上的油脂擦掉了。
words.en: Grease is a thick, oily substance which is put on the moving parts of cars and other machines in order to make them work smoothly.

words.ex: The greasy pan needed a good wash.
words.ex_cn: 这个油污的平底锅需要好好洗一洗。
words.en: Something that is greasy has a lot of grease or oil on it or in it.

words.ex: He bought a bottle of liquor for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对买了一瓶酒。
words.en: Liquor is an alcoholic drink that is made by distillation rather than by fermentation.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.ex: He felt the repression of his true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了压抑自己真实情感的痛苦。
words.en: Repression is the act of subduing someone or something by force, or the state of being subdued in such a way.

words.ex: He lives in a big mansion near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一座大宅子里。
words.en: A mansion is a very large, impressive house, especially one that is the home of a wealthy or important person.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.ex: Pandas and bamboo coexist in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫和竹子在野外共存。
words.en: The state or fact of existing at the same time or in the same place.

words.tr: v. 捐赠；订阅；订购；签署；认购（股份）
words.ex: He decided to subscribe $50 to the charity each month.
words.ex_cn: 他决定每月向慈善机构捐赠50美元。
words.en: If you subscribe to a magazine or a service, you pay to receive it regularly.

words.ex: The rotten food has a bad odor.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂的食物有一种难闻的气味。
words.en: An odor is a particular and distinctive smell.

words.ex: The garden has a botanical section for native plants.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园有一个专门种植本地植物的植物区。
words.en: Relating to plants or the scientific study of plants.

words.ex: The dentist found a cavity in his tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医在他的牙齿上发现了一个腔。
words.en: A cavity is a hole or space inside something.

words.ex: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。
words.en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged; to transfer the ownership of property to another.

words.ex: He is intolerant of people who are late.
words.ex_cn: 他不能容忍迟到的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as intolerant, you mean that they do not accept behavior and opinions that are different from their own.

words.tr: v. 谴责；强烈反对；悲叹
words.ex: He deplores the violence on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他谴责电视上的暴力。
words.en: If you deplore something, you think it is very wrong or very bad.

words.tr:
adj. 麻木的；失去知觉的
v. 使麻木；使迟钝
words.ex: His fingers felt numb after being in the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他的手指在寒冷中变得麻木。
words.en: If a part of your body is numb, you cannot feel it, usually for a short time.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.ex: The cave dweller lives alone in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 洞穴居民独自住在山里。
words.en: A dweller is a person or animal that lives in or at a specified place.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text B - Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 与……汇聚；与……趋同；在某一点上会合
words.ex: The two roads converge with each other near the park.
words.ex_cn: 两条路在公园附近交汇。
words.en: To meet, join, or come together with something, often at a point or in a common purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 主持（会议、仪式等）；掌管；对…负责
words.ex: The judge will preside over the trial next week.
words.ex_cn: 法官将于下周主持审判。
words.en: If you preside over a meeting or an event, you are in charge of it and have to make sure that it runs smoothly.

words.ex: The obedient child cleaned his room without being told.
words.ex_cn: 这个听话的孩子没被要求就打扫了房间。
words.en: An obedient person or animal does what they are told to do.

words.ex: He will remold the clay into a new shape.
words.ex_cn: 他将把泥土重新塑造成一个新的形状。
words.en: To remold means to shape or form something again, especially in a different way.

words.ex: He disconnects the cable from the TV.
words.ex_cn: 他把电缆从电视上拔掉。
words.en: To disconnect something means to separate it from something else to which it is attached or connected.

words.tr: phrase. 被绑在；被系在；被束缚
words.ex_cn: 他整天都离不开手机。
words.en: To be closely connected or associated with something; to be bound or restricted by something.

words.ex: He likes to lean against the wall when he talks to friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时喜欢靠在墙上。
words.en: To rest or be supported against something for support.

words.tr: phrase. 把某物靠在另一物上；使某物倚靠某物
words.ex: He leans the ladder against the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把梯子靠在墙上。
words.en: To place an object so that it rests or is supported by leaning against another object.

words.tr: phrase. 靠在…上；依赖；施压；威胁
words.ex: He leaned on the wall to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他靠在墙上休息。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support or assistance, or to apply pressure in order to influence someone.

words.tr: phrase. 剥落；脱掉；脱离；离队
words.ex: The paint is starting to peel off the walls.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的油漆开始剥落了。
words.en: If you peel off a surface layer or covering from something, you remove it by pulling it away.

words.tr: phrase. 剥掉某物；撕下某物；脱掉（衣物等）
words.ex: He peeled the sticker off the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把贴纸从瓶子上撕下来。
words.en: To remove the outer covering or layer from something.

words.ex: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。
words.en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged; to transfer the ownership of property to another.

words.tr: phrase. 对…不能容忍的；不容许…的
words.ex: He is intolerant of loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他无法忍受嘈杂的声音。
words.en: To not accept or be willing to accept opinions, beliefs, or behaviors that are different from one's own.

words.tr: phrase. 使突然陷入；投身于；跳入；投入（某活动或状态）
words.ex: He likes to plunge into cold water in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天跳进冷水里。
words.en: To start to do something suddenly and with a lot of energy, often without thinking about it first.

words.tr: phrase. 排除某物；不让某物进入；忽视某事
words.ex: He shut out the noise and focused on his book.
words.ex_cn: 他屏蔽了噪音，专心看书。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place or being involved in an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 排斥某人；不让某人参与；把某人关在外面
words.ex: The noise shut out the children.
words.ex_cn: 噪音把孩子们挡在外面。
words.en: To prevent someone from entering a place or participating in an activity.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.ex: The document is confidential and cannot be shared.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是机密的，不能分享。
words.en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

words.tr: adv. 秘密地; 亲密地，十分信任地
words.ex: He told me the secret confidentially.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地告诉我这个秘密。
words.en: If you tell someone something confidentially, you tell them in secret, trusting that they will not tell anyone else.

words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.ex: He accepted a nominal fee for the service.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项服务收取了微不足道的费用。
words.en: If you say that something is nominal, you mean that it is very small in comparison to the real value or importance of something.

words.ex: He is an emigrant from China.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自中国的移民。
words.en: An emigrant is a person who leaves their own country to live permanently in another country.

words.ex: It is a taboo to speak his name in this village.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村子里，提到他的名字是禁忌。
words.en: A taboo is a social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or forbidding association with a particular person, place, or thing.

words.tr:
n. 扇贝；扇形饰边
v. 拾扇贝；使成扇形
words.ex: She collected scallop shells on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她在海滩上收集扇贝壳。
words.en: A scallop is a type of shellfish with two fan-shaped shells. Scallops can be eaten as food, and their shells are often used for decoration.

words.ex: He adds garlic to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加蒜来提味。
words.en: A strong-smelling pungent-tasting bulb, used as a flavoring in cooking and in herbal medicine.

words.tr:
n. 侧面；侧翼；胁腹
v. 在…侧面（有）
words.ex: The soldiers moved to the flank to avoid the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们移动到侧翼以避开敌人。
words.en: The side of something, especially a part of the body between the ribs and the hip; to be situated on each side of or on one side of (something).

words.ex: He eats a cucumber for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一根黄瓜。
words.en: A cucumber is a long, green vegetable with a high water content, used in salads and for pickling.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝地抱怨；嘀咕
n. 咕哝地抱怨；嘀咕
words.ex: He mutters under his breath when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 当他生气时，他会低声嘟囔。
words.en: To speak or say something in a low voice that is hard to hear, often because you are annoyed or complaining.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.tr:
n. 箔；陪衬物
v. 阻止；挫败
words.ex: He used foil to wrap the sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他用锡纸包住了三明治。
words.en: To prevent someone from succeeding in their plans or intentions, especially by doing something clever or unexpected.

words.tr: n. 地方法官；治安官；行政官；
words.ex: The magistrate decided the small case quickly.
words.ex_cn: 地方法官迅速裁决了这起小案件。
words.en: A magistrate is an official who acts as a judge in law courts that deal with minor crimes or disputes.

words.tr:
n. 违背；
v. 攻破；
words.ex: The company committed a breach of contract.
words.ex_cn: 该公司违反了合同。
words.en: A breach of a law, rule, or agreement is an act of breaking it.

words.ex: He knows good etiquette at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他知道晚餐时的礼貌规矩。
words.en: Etiquette refers to the customary code of polite behavior in society or among members of a particular profession or group.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.tr: n. 结构；布局；配置；外形
words.ex: The configuration of the computer is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑的配置非常简单。
words.en: The arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination.

words.ex: He fabricates excuses to avoid work.
words.ex_cn: 他编造借口来逃避工作。
words.en: To fabricate means to invent or produce something false in order to deceive someone.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: The government imposed censorship on the news.
words.ex_cn: 政府对新闻实施了审查。
words.en: Censorship is the censoring of books, plays, films, or reports, especially by government officials, because they are considered immoral or secret in some way.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.ex: He works in the aerospace industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在航空航天行业工作。
words.en: The branch of technology and industry concerned with both aviation and space flight.

words.tr:
v. 戳；刺；激励；督促
n. 戳；刺；催促
words.ex: He prodded the fire with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子戳了戳火。
words.en: To poke or jab someone or something, often with a finger or a pointed object, in order to get their attention or to encourage them to do something.

words.tr: v. 进行；继续；继续进行；“proceed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting is proceeding as planned.
words.ex_cn: 会议按计划进行。
words.en: A proceeding is an event or a series of actions, especially one that is formal or official.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.ex: The symbol x denotes an unknown number.
words.ex_cn: 符号 x 表示一个未知数。
words.en: If one thing denotes another, it is a sign or indication of it.

words.ex: He moved up to a higher bracket after his promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他升职后进入了更高的等级。
words.en: A bracket is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is fastened to a wall in order to support something such as a shelf. In writing, brackets are symbols that are used to separate words or numbers.

words.ex: There is an inconsistency between his words and actions.
words.ex_cn: 他的言行不一致。
words.en: The quality or state of being inconsistent; lack of consistency.

words.ex: The Gulf of Mexico is a large sea area.
words.ex_cn: 墨西哥湾是一个大型海域。
words.en: A gulf is a large area of sea that is partly surrounded by land.

words.ex: The spectator watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: A spectator is someone who watches an event, show, game, or activity.

words.ex: His deduction was based on the evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他的推论基于证据。
words.en: A deduction is a conclusion that you reach about something because of other things that you know to be true.

words.ex: The temporal change of seasons affects our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 季节的时间变化影响我们的日常生活。
words.en: Relating to time as opposed to eternity; relating to worldly life as opposed to spiritual life.

words.ex: The tree has many colorful ornaments.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树上有许多彩色的装饰品。
words.en: An ornament is an object that is used to make something look more attractive but is usually considered to have no practical purpose.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.tr: n. 不容忍；不容异己；偏狭
words.ex: He shows intolerance toward people who think differently.
words.ex_cn: 他对他人的不同想法表现出不容忍。
words.en: Intolerance is unwillingness to accept views, beliefs, or behavior that differ from one's own.

words.tr:
n. 司法部；司法制度；法官（总称）
adj. 司法的；法院的；法官的
words.ex: The judiciary made a fair decision.
words.ex_cn: 司法部做出了公正的裁决。
words.en: The judiciary is the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in the name of the state.

words.ex: He sent a malicious email to hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他发了一封怀恶意的邮件来伤害他的朋友。
words.en: If you describe someone's words or actions as malicious, you mean that they are intended to harm people or their reputation, or to cause them embarrassment and upset.

words.tr: adj. 荣誉的；名誉的；道义上的
words.ex: He received an honorary degree for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他因自己的工作获得了荣誉学位。
words.en: Given as an honor without the usual requirements or duties.

words.tr:
n. 筛子；滤器
v. 筛；滤
words.ex: He used a sieve to separate sand from pebbles.
words.ex_cn: 他用筛子把沙子和石子分开。
words.en: A sieve is a tool consisting of a wire or plastic mesh held in a frame, used for separating solids from liquids or larger particles from smaller ones.

words.tr: n. 准确；精确；细节；细微的差别
words.ex: The nicety of the measurement surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个测量的准确性让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A nicety is a fine detail or distinction, especially one that is considered to be important or elegant.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The table is made of a composite material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由一种合成材料制成的。
words.en: A composite is something that is made up of several different parts or materials.

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观是白色的。
words.en: The outer surface or structure of something.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text A - Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 饿死；因饥饿而死亡
words.ex: The old man starved to death because no one gave him food.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因为没人给他食物而饿死了。
words.en: To die from lack of food.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人饿死；通过断绝食物致某人死亡
words.ex: The cruel man starved the dog to death.
words.ex_cn: 那个残忍的人把狗饿死了。
words.en: To cause someone to die from lack of food.

words.tr: phrase. 饿死自己；绝食至死
words.ex: He tried to starve himself to death because he was very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他因为非常伤心试图饿死自己。
words.en: To deliberately not eat in order to cause one's own death.

words.ex: He is attached to his old phone.
words.ex_cn: 他依恋他的旧手机。
words.en: To be connected or joined to something, either physically or emotionally.

words.tr: phrase. 作为兼职；另外；暗地里
words.ex: He works as a teacher and drives a taxi on the side.
words.ex_cn: 他当老师，同时兼职开出租车。
words.en: If someone does something on the side, they do it in addition to their main job.

words.tr: phrase. 对…持怀疑态度的；怀疑…有问题的
words.ex_cn: 他怀疑那个陌生人的微笑。
words.en: To think that someone might be guilty of doing something wrong or dishonest.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进入正题；说重点；直截了当地说出主要问题
words.ex: Please get to the point; we don't have much time.
words.ex_cn: 请直奔主题，我们没有太多时间。
words.en: To speak or write directly and clearly about the most important part of a subject, without including unnecessary details.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进入正题；谈主要问题；切中要点
words.ex: He finally came to the point and told us the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他终于直截了当地告诉我们真相。
words.en: To directly address the main issue or topic without unnecessary details.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；四处游荡；漫无目的地走动
words.ex: The children wander around the park every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午都在公园里闲逛。
words.en: To move about without a definite destination or purpose.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.ex: This sample is representative of the whole group.
words.ex_cn: 这个样本代表了整个群体。
words.en: To be typical of a particular group or thing; to serve as a symbol or example of something.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.tr: v. 确定；定案；最终确定
words.ex: He will finalize the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会最终确定这个计划。
words.en: To finalize something means to complete all the arrangements for it, especially by discussing it with other people involved.

words.ex: The merger of two companies created a bigger business.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司的合并创建了一家更大的企业。
words.en: A merger is the joining together of two separate companies or organizations so that they become one.

words.ex: Dubai is one of the seven emirates in the UAE.
words.ex_cn: 迪拜是阿联酋七个酋长国之一。
words.en: An emirate is a political territory that is ruled by a dynastic Islamic monarch styled as an emir.

words.ex: The police will detain the suspect for questioning.
words.ex_cn: 警察将扣留嫌疑人进行审问。
words.en: If someone is detained, they are officially held in a place, especially a prison, and are not allowed to leave.

words.ex: He wrote a memorandum about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于会议的备忘录。
words.en: A memorandum is a written proposal or reminder, especially in a business context.

words.ex: He compiles data from many surveys.
words.ex_cn: 他汇编来自许多调查的数据。
words.en: To compile means to collect information from different places and arrange it in a book, report, or list.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.tr:
adj. 小数的；十进位的
n. 小数
words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the decimal part.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in a special form. It is based on powers of ten, and it uses a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part.

words.ex: The city hosted an exposition last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年夏天举办了一场博览会。
words.en: An exposition is a detailed explanation or description of an idea or theory. It can also refer to a large public exhibition of art or trade goods.

words.ex: The doctor will certify that you are healthy.
words.ex_cn: 医生将证明你身体健康。
words.en: To officially declare something to be true, correct, or genuine, often in writing.

words.ex: She tied a red ribbon around the box.
words.ex_cn: 她把一条红色的带状物系在盒子上。
words.en: A ribbon is a long, narrow piece of cloth that you use for tying things together or as a decoration.

words.tr: phrase. 一流的；顶级的；最优的（常用来形容质量或地位最高的事物）
words.ex: He won a blue ribbon at the school fair.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校集市上赢得了一条蓝丝带。
words.en: A blue ribbon is a strip of blue-colored ribbon given as a prize or to indicate high quality or honor.

words.ex: He drives a red convertible on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末开一辆红色敞篷车。
words.en: A convertible is a car with a roof that can be folded down or removed.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.ex: They plant trees to commemorate the fallen soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的士兵。
words.en: To commemorate an important event or person means to remember them by means of a special action, ceremony, or specially created object.

words.tr: n. 简介；情况介绍会； v. “brief”的现在分词；
words.ex: The manager gave a briefing before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议前，经理做了一个简介。
words.en: A briefing is a meeting in which people are given information or instructions.

words.tr:
v. 绑架；劫持；诱拐
n. 绑架罪
words.ex: The man tried to kidnap the little girl.
words.ex_cn: 这个人试图绑架那个小女孩。
words.en: To take someone away illegally by force, typically to obtain a ransom.

words.tr:
adj. 恼火的；激怒的
v. 使恼怒；使恶化；使加剧；“exasperate”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was exasperated by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被那阵噪音气得发疯。
words.en: If you describe someone as exasperated, you mean that they are frustrated or angry because of something that is happening or something that another person is doing.

words.ex: The police did an interrogation at night.
words.ex_cn: 警察在晚上进行了审问。
words.en: The process of asking someone a lot of questions in order to get information, especially in a police or military context.

words.ex: The score was nil at the end of the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束时分数为零。
words.en: Nothing or none; used to indicate the absence of something.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reel.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕在卷筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. It can also refer to a lively Scottish or Irish dance, or to the act of staggering or lurching violently.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.tr:
n. 降落伞
v. 跳伞；用降落伞空投
words.ex: He jumped from the plane and opened his parachute.
words.ex_cn: 他从飞机上跳下并打开了降落伞。
words.en: A parachute is a device used to slow the motion of an object through an atmosphere by creating drag.

words.tr: n. 公牛；大型雄性动物；胡扯；废话
words.ex: The bull charged at the matador.
words.ex_cn: 公牛冲向了斗牛士。
words.en: A bull is a male animal of the cattle family, or a male elephant, whale, or other large animal. In finance, a bull is someone who buys shares in the expectation that their value will rise.

words.ex: The movie got a high rating from viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了观众的高评分。
words.en: A rating is a classification or ranking of someone or something based on a comparative assessment of their quality, standard, or performance.

words.tr: n. 社会学家；社会学者；
words.ex: The sociologist studied how people live in cities.
words.ex_cn: 这位社会学家研究了人们在城市中的生活方式。
words.en: A sociologist is someone who studies or is an expert in sociology, which is the study of society and social behavior.

words.ex: The team's cohesion helped them win the match.
words.ex_cn: 团队的凝聚力帮助他们赢得了比赛。
words.en: Cohesion refers to the action or fact of forming a united whole, especially in the context of a group of people or the parts of a substance.

words.tr:
adj. 反动的；保守的
n. 反动派；保守人士
words.ex: The reactionary government banned free speech.
words.ex_cn: 这个反动政府禁止了言论自由。
words.en: A reactionary person or group tries to prevent changes in the political or social system of their country.

words.ex: He is the nominee for best actor.
words.ex_cn: 他是最佳男演员的提名人。
words.en: A nominee is someone who is proposed for an official position or for an honour or award.

words.ex: The climax of the movie was a big chase scene.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的高潮是一场大追捕场景。
words.en: The climax is the most exciting or important part of a play, film, or piece of music, which usually happens near the end.

words.ex: The unification of the two countries brought peace.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家的统一带来了和平。
words.en: The process of making or becoming a single unit.

words.ex: The workers showed solidarity during the strike.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在罢工期间表现出团结。
words.en: Solidarity is unity or agreement of feeling or action, especially among individuals with a common interest; mutual support within a group.

words.ex: The train has a sleeping compartment for passengers.
words.ex_cn: 火车上有一个供乘客休息的隔间。
words.en: A compartment is a separate section or part of something, especially a space in a vehicle that is separated from other spaces.

words.ex: She tried to compartmentalize her work and personal life.
words.ex_cn: 她试图将工作和私人生活分开。
words.en: To compartmentalize something means to divide it into separate sections or categories.

words.ex: The committee will convene tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 委员会明天将召开会议。
words.en: If someone convenes a meeting or conference, they arrange for it to take place. They can also be said to convene when they meet.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: The nail fits into the groove.
words.ex_cn: 钉子卡在槽里。
words.en: A groove is a long, narrow space or cut in a surface, often made to guide the movement of something or to hold something in place. It can also refer to a settled routine or way of doing things that is hard to change.

words.tr:
adj. 哑的；无声的
n. 哑巴；沉默的人
v. 减弱…的声音
words.ex: He stayed mute during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间保持沉默。
words.en: If someone is mute, they are unable to speak.

words.tr: adj. 机智的；圆滑的；得体的
words.ex: He was tactful when he said no to her request.
words.ex_cn: 当他拒绝她的请求时，他很得体。
words.en: If you describe someone as tactful, you approve of them because they are careful not to say or do anything that would offend or upset other people.

words.ex: He was courteous to everyone he met.
words.ex_cn: 他对遇到的每个人都很有礼貌。
words.en: Someone who is courteous is polite and respectful to other people.

words.ex: He checked the glossary for the meaning of new words.
words.ex_cn: 他查阅了术语表以了解新词的含义。
words.en: A glossary is a list of terms in a particular domain of knowledge with the definitions for those terms.

words.ex: He asked for clarification about the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他要求对规则进行澄清。
words.en: A clarification is a statement that makes something clear or easier to understand.

words.ex: He tries to mediate between the two friends.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在两个朋友之间调解。
words.en: To intervene between people or parties in order to bring about an agreement or reconciliation.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text B - Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 对…有影响；对…起作用；产生效果
words.ex: Smoking has an impact on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有影响。
words.en: To have a significant effect on someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人负责；使某人掌管；把某事交由某人负责
words.ex: The manager put Tom in charge of the project.
words.ex_cn: 经理让汤姆负责这个项目。
words.en: To assign someone the responsibility for a particular task or area.

words.w: put sb. in charge of sb.
words.tr: phrase. 让某人负责管理/照看某人
words.uk: pʊt ˈsʌmbədi ɪn tʃɑːdʒ əv ˈsʌmbədi
words.us: pʊt ˈsʌmbədi ɪn tʃɑːrdʒ əv ˈsʌmbədi
words.ex: The teacher put Tom in charge of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师让汤姆负责这个班级。
words.en: To assign someone the responsibility of overseeing or managing another person or a group.

words.w: put sb. in charge of sth.
words.tr: phrase. 让某人负责某事；把某事交由某人主管
words.uk: pʊt ˈsʌmbədi ɪn tʃɑːdʒ əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: pʊt ˈsʌmbɑdi ɪn tʃɑrdʒ əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: The teacher put Tom in charge of the class project.
words.ex_cn: 老师让汤姆负责这个班级项目。
words.en: To give someone the responsibility for something.

words.tr: phrase. 达成交易；完成协议；敲定生意
words.ex: He closed the deal with a handshake.
words.ex_cn: 他通过握手达成了交易。
words.en: To finalize an agreement or business transaction.

words.tr: phrase. 达成协议；完成交易
words.ex: They closed a deal yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨天达成了协议。
words.en: To successfully conclude a business agreement or transaction.

words.tr: phrase. 达成协议；敲定交易；使事情最终确定
words.ex: He shook her hand to seal the deal.
words.ex_cn: 他和她握手以敲定这笔交易。
words.en: To conclude a business agreement or transaction successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 达成协议；敲定交易
words.ex: They shook hands to seal a deal.
words.ex_cn: 他们握手以达成协议。
words.en: To finalize or confirm an agreement or transaction.

words.ex: They divert water to the dry fields.
words.ex_cn: 他们把水引到干旱的田地里。
words.en: To redirect or turn aside something to a different destination or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 冲进；猛冲入；鲁莽地进入
words.ex: The dog charged into the yard and barked loudly.
words.ex_cn: 那只狗冲进院子里，大声吠叫。
words.en: To rush or move quickly and forcefully into a place or situation, often with a sense of urgency or aggression.

words.tr: phrase. 快速冲下；向…猛冲而下
words.ex: The soldier will charge down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这名士兵将向山下冲锋。
words.en: To rush forward or move quickly and forcefully towards something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事采取……的方式／方法（常用于表达处理问题或事务的态度或策略）
words.ex: He takes a careful approach to solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他采取谨慎的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: To deal with something in a particular way or manner.

words.tr: phrase. 挑出某人；特别选出某人（尤指给予特殊待遇或批评）
words.ex: The teacher singled out Tom for asking the best question.
words.ex_cn: 老师挑出了汤姆，因为他问了最好的问题。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group for special attention.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事物纳入/融入某事物；使某事物并入某事物
words.ex: The company decided to incorporate the new technology into its existing products.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定将新技术融入其现有产品中。
words.en: To include something as part of something else.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: The city improved its power grid to handle more electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其电力输送网，以承载更多的电力。
words.en: A grid is a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares. It is used to help you draw or to help you find places on a map.

words.tr: n. 联邦；共和国；联合体；
words.ex: Australia is a member of the Commonwealth.
words.ex_cn: 澳大利亚是联邦的成员。
words.en: A commonwealth is a traditional English term for a political community founded for the common good. Historically, it has been synonymous with 'republic'.

words.ex: The rooster crows every morning.
words.ex_cn: 公鸡每天早上打鸣。
words.en: A rooster is an adult male chicken.

words.ex: A crow sat on the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 一只乌鸦坐在树枝上。
words.en: A crow is a large black bird which makes a loud, harsh noise. If someone crows, they talk in a very proud way about something they have done or achieved.

words.ex: The shepherd walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人每天早上都带着他的羊走路。
words.en: A shepherd is a person whose job is to look after sheep. As a verb, it means to guide or direct someone or something in a particular direction.

words.tr:
v. 焊接
n. 焊接
words.ex: He welds metal pieces together with a torch.
words.ex_cn: 他用焊枪把金属片焊接在一起。
words.en: To join pieces of metal together by heating the surfaces until they melt and pressing them together.

words.ex: The welder fixes metal parts with heat.
words.ex_cn: 焊工用热量焊接金属部件。
words.en: A welder is a person whose job is welding metal.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: Oil helps to lubricate the engine parts.
words.ex_cn: 油有助于润滑发动机部件。
words.en: To apply a substance such as oil or grease to (something) in order to minimize friction and allow smooth movement.

words.tr: n. 大片土地；体内管道；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large tract of land near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有靠近河边的一大片土地。
words.en: A tract is a large area of land or a system of connected organs in the body.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.ex: He eats too much sugar and his liver is hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多糖，他的肝脏受损了。
words.en: The liver is a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile, or a person who lives in a particular way.

words.ex: The wire is made of copper.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线是铜制的。
words.en: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used especially for making wire and coins.

words.ex: He drank coffee from a large mug.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个大杯子里喝咖啡。
words.en: A mug is a large, deep cup with straight sides and a handle, used for hot drinks. It can also refer to someone's face or a foolish person. As a verb, it means to attack and rob someone violently in a public place.

words.ex: The brewery makes fresh beer every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家啤酒厂每天生产新鲜的啤酒。
words.en: A brewery is a place where beer is made commercially.

words.ex: The horses run fast on the racecourse.
words.ex_cn: 马在赛马场跑得很快。
words.en: A racecourse is a track or ground where races are held, especially horse races.

words.ex: He hurt his spinal cord in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中伤到了脊髓。
words.en: Relating to the spine or the spinal cord.

words.ex: He hurt his rib when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了肋骨。
words.en: A rib is one of the long curved bones that are connected to the spine and surround the chest.

words.ex: He has an ulcer from eating too much spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多辣食而得了溃疡。
words.en: An ulcer is a sore area on the skin or inside the body that is very painful and may bleed or produce a poisonous substance.

words.tr: adj. 眼的；视觉的；光学的
words.ex: He wears optic glasses to see clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴光学眼镜以便看得清楚。
words.en: Relating to the eye or vision.

words.ex: The receptor detects the signal from the hormone.
words.ex_cn: 受体检测激素的信号。
words.en: A receptor is a cell or a group of cells that receives stimuli.

words.tr:
n. 殉道者；殉教者；烈士
v. 处死；折磨
words.ex: He became a martyr for freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他为自由而成为烈士。
words.en: A martyr is someone who is killed or made to suffer greatly because of their religious or political beliefs, and is admired and respected by people who share those beliefs.

words.tr: n. 爱国主义；爱国精神；
words.ex: He showed patriotism by serving his country in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在军队中为国家服务表现出爱国主义。
words.en: Patriotism is the love and devotion to one's country.

words.ex: The soldiers defended the fort during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在战斗中保卫了堡垒。
words.en: A fort is a strong building or a place with a wall or fence around it where soldiers can stay and be safe from the enemy.

words.ex: The soldiers stayed at the remote outpost.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们驻守在偏远的前哨站。
words.en: An outpost is a small military camp or position at some distance from the main army, used especially as a guard against surprise attack.

words.tr:
v. 猛扭；扭伤；挣脱
n. 扳手；扳钳；（离别的）痛苦
words.ex: He wrenched the door open with all his strength.
words.ex_cn: 他用尽全力猛扭门，把它打开了。
words.en: A wrench is a tool used for gripping and turning nuts, bolts, pipes, etc. It can also refer to a sudden violent twist or pull, or a feeling of sadness or distress caused by separation.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.tr:
v. 征收；征税；征募
n. 征兵；征税
words.ex: The government will levy a new tax next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将征收一项新税。
words.en: To levy means to impose or collect a tax, fee, or fine. It can also refer to the act of enlisting or drafting individuals into military service.

words.tr:
n. 最高统治者；君主；元首
adj. 独立自主的；拥有最高统治权的
words.ex: The sovereign makes important decisions for the country.
words.ex_cn: 君主为国家做出重要决定。
words.en: A sovereign is a king, queen, or other supreme ruler.

words.ex: They traverse the forest to reach the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们横穿森林去到达村庄。
words.en: To traverse something means to move or travel across it, often with some difficulty.

words.ex: He allegedly stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 据他声称，他偷了钱。
words.en: Used to convey that something is claimed to be the case or have taken place, although there is no proof.

words.tr:
n. 楔子；三角木；楔形物
v. 把…楔住 ；将…挤入（或塞进、插入）
words.ex: He used a wedge to split the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用楔子把木头劈开。
words.en: A wedge is a piece of wood, metal, or other material with one thick end and one thin edge, used to keep something in position or to split something apart.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: The old mill stands by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊坐落在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour. It can also refer to a factory where certain materials are processed or manufactured.

words.ex: He paid with a fifty-dollar banknote.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张五十美元的纸币付款。
words.en: A banknote is a piece of paper money, especially one issued by a central bank.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: The boxer is a lightweight fighter.
words.ex_cn: 这位拳击手是一名轻量级选手。
words.en: Something that is lightweight weighs less than average or is less heavy than usual. It can also refer to someone who is not very important or influential.

words.tr: n. 优惠券；息票；配给券
words.ex: He used a coupon to buy milk at half price.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张优惠券以半价买了牛奶。
words.en: A coupon is a piece of printed paper that allows you to pay less money than usual for a product, or to get it free.

words.ex: He went on an errand to buy milk.
words.ex_cn: 他去买牛奶了。
words.en: An errand is a short journey that you make in order to do a job for someone, for example when you go to a shop to buy something for them.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.tr:
v. 闪耀；闪烁
n. 闪烁
words.ex: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中闪烁。
words.en: If a star or a light twinkles, it shines with an unsteady light that rapidly and gently changes from bright to faint.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.ex: He uses deductive reasoning to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他使用演绎推理来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Deductive reasoning is a logical process in which a conclusion is based on the concordance of multiple premises that are generally assumed to be true.

words.tr: n. 网球拍；喧闹；非法勾当；
words.ex: He bought a new racket for tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一副新的网球拍。
words.en: A racket is a piece of equipment used in sports such as tennis or badminton, consisting of a handle and a round or oval frame with a network of strings stretched across it. It can also refer to a loud, unpleasant noise or a dishonest or fraudulent scheme.

words.ex: The law will emancipate slaves.
words.ex_cn: 法律将解放奴隶。
words.en: To emancipate someone means to set them free from something that restricts their freedom to do what they want.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.ex: The butterfly is symmetrical.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶是对称的。
words.en: Something that is symmetrical has parts that are equal in size, shape, and position, and that are arranged in a balanced way.

words.tr: adv. 对称性地，对称地，平衡地
words.ex: The two sides are symmetrically placed.
words.ex_cn: 两边是对称放置的。
words.en: In a way that is symmetrical; with symmetry.

words.tr: adj. 共和国的；共和政体的；
words.ex: The republican government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 共和国政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A republican is a person who supports or belongs to the Republican Party, which is one of the two main political parties in the United States. It can also refer to someone who supports a republic as a form of government.

words.tr: n. 阁下；贵族身分（或权威）；统治
words.ex: The lordship welcomed the guests with kindness.
words.ex_cn: 阁下以仁慈欢迎了宾客。
words.en: Lordship is a title used to address or refer to a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain.

words.ex: The rebellion against the king failed.
words.ex_cn: 反对国王的叛乱失败了。
words.en: A rebellion is an organized attempt to overthrow a government or authority by a group of people.

words.ex: The mediator helped the two sides reach an agreement.
words.ex_cn: 调解人帮助双方达成了协议。
words.en: A mediator is a person who tries to end a disagreement by helping the two sides to talk about and agree on a solution.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text A - Phrases and expressions

words.ex: They live off-grid in a small cabin.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在一座小木屋里，远离电网。
words.en: Living or operating independently of public utilities, especially the supply of electricity.

words.tr: phrase. /adj. 脱离电网的；不依赖公共供电的；远离尘嚣的；隐居的
words.ex: They decided to live off the grid, relying on solar panels and a well for water.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定脱离电网生活，依靠太阳能电池板和水井供水。
words.en: Not connected to the main or national electrical grid; not connected to or served by publicly or commercially managed utilities (such as electricity, water supply, or sewage disposal).

words.tr: phrase. 勉强维持；勉强通过；勉强过活
words.ex: He scrapes by on a small salary.
words.ex_cn: 他靠微薄的薪水勉强维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do something with difficulty, especially by using very little money.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.tr: phrase. 跑腿；办杂事；外出处理琐碎事务
words.ex: I run errands every Saturday morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每个星期六上午都去跑腿办事。
words.en: To go out to do small tasks or jobs, especially for someone else.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅迎合素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater to someone or something means to provide them with all the things they need or want.

words.tr: phrase. 发出巨大噪音；大吵大闹；制造喧闹
words.ex: The children make a racket when they play.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们玩耍时吵得很厉害。
words.en: To make a loud, disruptive noise, often causing a disturbance.

words.ex: The law will emancipate slaves.
words.ex_cn: 法律将解放奴隶。
words.en: To emancipate someone means to set them free from something that restricts their freedom to do what they want.

words.tr: 短语. 对某事有发言权；能参与决定某事
words.ex: I want a say on where we go for vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我想对去哪里度假发表意见。
words.en: To have a voice or influence in a decision or matter.

words.ex: Please say over the sentence again.
words.ex_cn: 请把这句话再说一遍。
words.en: To have authority or control over something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某事有发言权；能参与决定某事
words.ex: I want to have a say on where we go for vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我想对去哪里度假发表意见。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to express one's opinion or influence a decision about something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某事有发言权；能参与决定某事
words.ex: Parents should have a say over their child's education.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该对孩子的教育有发言权。
words.en: To have the right or power to influence or make decisions about something.

words.tr:
n. 女权主义者
adj. 女权主义的
words.ex: She is a feminist who believes in equal rights.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位相信平等权利的女权主义者。
words.en: A feminist is a person who believes in and supports the rights and equality of women.

words.tr: n. 女权运动；男女平等主义
words.ex: She believes in feminism and wants equal rights for women.
words.ex_cn: 她相信女权主义，希望女性享有平等权利。
words.en: Feminism is the belief and aim that women should have the same rights, power, and opportunities as men.

words.ex: The obscene behavior shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这种可憎的行为让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: If you describe something as obscene, you mean it offends you because it relates to sex or violence in a way that you think is unpleasant and shocking.

words.ex: He refuses to accept the dogma of the church.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝接受教会的教条。
words.en: A principle or set of principles laid down by an authority as incontrovertibly true.

words.ex: The government is struggling to control the ongoing insurgency.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在努力控制持续的叛乱。
words.en: An insurgency is a violent attempt to oppose a country's government carried out by citizens of that country.

words.tr: v. 取代；迫使…离开家园；
words.ex: The new robot will displace the workers on the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 这个新机器人将取代装配线上的工人。
words.en: To displace something or someone means to take their place or to force them to leave their usual place or role.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.tr: v. 蒸馏；用蒸馏法提取；蒸馏出；提炼
words.ex: They distill water to remove impurities.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过蒸馏去除水中的杂质。
words.en: To distill a liquid means to purify it by heating it until it becomes a gas and then cooling it so that it becomes a liquid again. This process can also be used to extract the essential elements or meanings from something.

words.tr: adj. 古怪的；难以解释的
words.ex: He is queer and proud of who he is.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，并为自己是谁而自豪。
words.en: Queer is used to describe something that is strange or unusual, or someone who is homosexual.

words.ex: Europeans colonized many parts of Africa in the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 欧洲人在19世纪开拓了非洲的许多地区。
words.en: To colonize means to send people to live in and govern another country.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；一刹那；
v. 闪光；闪现；
words.ex: The camera captured a sudden flash of light.
words.ex_cn: 相机捕捉到了一道突然的闪光。
words.en: A flash is a sudden bright light that quickly disappears. As a verb, it means to shine brightly for a short time or to appear or pass suddenly.

words.ex: The student was sent to detention for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这名学生因违反规则被留校滞留。
words.en: Detention is the act of detaining someone or the state of being detained in official custody, especially as a political prisoner.

words.ex: The execution of the criminal was carried out last night.
words.ex_cn: 这名罪犯的处决昨晚执行了。
words.en: The carrying out or performance of a task, plan, or order.

words.ex: The forest is a virgin land, untouched by humans.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是未开发的土地，从未被人类触及过。
words.en: A virgin is someone who has never had sexual intercourse. It can also describe something that is in its original pure or natural condition and has not been touched or changed by people.

words.tr: adj. 司法的；法庭的；审判的；
words.ex: The judicial system protects people's rights.
words.ex_cn: 司法系统保护人民的权利。
words.en: Judicial means relating to the legal system and to judgments made in a court of law.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The pilgrim walked to the holy place.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者步行前往圣地。
words.en: A pilgrim is a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons.

words.ex: The old house has a colonial style.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子具有殖民地风格。
words.en: Colonial means relating to a system or period of colonization, or to the people who live in a colony.

words.ex: The small isle is surrounded by blue sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小岛被蓝色的海洋环绕着。
words.en: An isle is a small island.

words.ex: The king sat on the throne.
words.ex_cn: 国王坐在王位上。
words.en: The throne is the special chair used by a king, queen, or emperor during ceremonies, or the position of being a ruler.

words.ex: The people tried to overthrow the corrupt government.
words.ex_cn: 人民试图推翻腐败的政府。
words.en: To overthrow a government or a leader means to remove them from power, often by force.

words.tr: adj. 歧视的；差别待遇的
words.ex: The rule is discriminatory because it treats people differently.
words.ex_cn: 这个规定是歧视性的，因为它对人们区别对待。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as discriminatory, you mean that they unfairly treat one person or group worse than others because of their race, gender, sexuality, or other characteristic.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.tr: adj. 与选举有关的；选举的
words.ex: He won the electoral vote by a small margin.
words.ex_cn: 他以微弱优势赢得了选举人票。
words.en: Relating to elections or electors.

words.ex: The senate voted to pass the new law.
words.ex_cn: 参议院投票通过了这项新法律。
words.en: The Senate is the smaller and more important of the two parts of the parliament in some countries, for example in the United States and Australia.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.tr: n. 抹刀；调色刀；刮勺；刮铲
words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子翻了煎饼。
words.en: A spatula is a tool with a broad, flat, flexible blade used for mixing, spreading, and lifting materials.

words.ex: The sponge lives in the ocean and filters water for food.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵动物生活在海洋中，通过过滤水来获取食物。
words.en: A sponge is a piece of a soft, light, porous substance originally from the skeletons of marine creatures, used for washing, cleaning, or padding. As a verb, it means to wipe, rub, or clean with a sponge or to absorb something.

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.ex: She added some kidney beans to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一些菜豆。
words.en: A kidney bean is a type of bean that is shaped like a kidney and is commonly used in cooking.

words.ex: The lab technician transcribes the DNA sequence into RNA.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员将DNA序列转录成RNA。
words.en: To transcribe something means to write it down or to copy it from one form of recording to another.

words.ex: The midwife helped the baby come out safely.
words.ex_cn: 助产士帮助婴儿安全出生。
words.en: A midwife is a person, usually a woman, who is trained to help women during childbirth.

words.tr: n. 隔离；分离；种族隔离；
words.ex: The school practiced racial segregation in the past.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校过去实行种族隔离。
words.en: Segregation is the policy or practice of separating people of different races, sexes, or religions and treating them in a different way.

words.ex: He won a trophy for first place in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得第一名，赢得了一个奖杯。
words.en: A trophy is a prize, such as a gold or silver cup, that is given to the winner of a competition or race.

words.tr: phrase. 花瓶妻子；指因外貌出众而被成功男性娶为妻子的女性，通常暗示其价值主要在于外表而非其他特质
words.ex: He married a trophy wife who is young and beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 他娶了一位年轻漂亮的花瓶妻子。
words.en: A trophy wife is a wife who is regarded as a status symbol for her husband, often younger and more attractive than him.

words.ex: The liner sailed across the ocean with hundreds of passengers.
words.ex_cn: 这艘邮轮载着数百名乘客横渡了海洋。
words.en: A liner is a large ship that carries passengers on regular journeys.

words.ex: The robbers took a hostage during the bank robbery.
words.ex_cn: 劫匪在银行抢劫时抓了一名人质。
words.en: A hostage is someone who has been captured by a person or organization and who may be killed or injured if people do not do what that person or organization demands.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.ex: He hired a solicitor to help with his house sale.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名事务律师来帮助处理他的房屋出售。
words.en: A solicitor is a lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares legal documents, especially in England.

words.ex: The children said they saw a ghost in the old house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们说他们在老房子里看到了一个鬼。
words.en: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that some people believe they can see or feel.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.tr: v. 熄灭；平息；抑制（欲望）；用水冷却
words.ex: He quenched the fire with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水熄灭了火。
words.en: To satisfy one's thirst or to extinguish a fire or to suppress a feeling or desire.

words.ex: The appendix contains extra data for the report.
words.ex_cn: 附录包含了报告的额外数据。
words.en: An appendix is a section at the end of a book that contains additional information. It can also refer to the small tube attached to the large intestine in the human body, known as the vermiform appendix.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.tr:
adj. 过去的
n. 过去的事
words.ex: He liked to talk about bygone days with his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢和祖父谈论过去的时光。
words.en: Belonging to an earlier time.

words.ex: The Industrial Revolution was a new epoch in history.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命是历史上一个新时代。
words.en: An epoch is a period of time in history or a person's life, typically one marked by notable events or particular characteristics.

words.ex: The guard is vigilant at night.
words.ex_cn: 这名守卫在夜里非常警惕。
words.en: Someone who is vigilant gives careful attention to a particular problem or situation and concentrates on noticing any danger or trouble that there might be.

words.ex: The continuance of the drought has caused severe water shortages.
words.ex_cn: 干旱的持续导致了严重的水资源短缺。
words.en: The continuance of something is its continuing existence or presence.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text B - Phrases and expressions

words.ex: The school forbids students to use phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: To prohibit someone from doing something, often by authority or law.

words.tr: phrase. 料理家务；管理家务；当家
words.ex: She keeps house for her family every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为家人操持家务。
words.en: To manage the household; to take care of the domestic chores.

words.tr: phrase. 将某人从某处驱逐出去；强行赶出
words.ex: The teacher ejected him from the class for breaking rules.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他违反规则而把他赶出了教室。
words.en: To force someone to leave a place or position.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.tr: phrase. 违背某人意愿地；强迫地
words.ex: He was forced to leave the country against his will.
words.ex_cn: 他被强迫离开这个国家，违背了他的意愿。
words.en: If something is done against one's will, it is done without one's consent or desire.

words.ex: He will run for mayor next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将竞选市长。
words.en: To compete for a position or office in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 轻视某人；看不起某人
words.ex: She always looks down on people who are less successful than her.
words.ex_cn: 她总是瞧不起那些不如她成功的人。
words.en: To regard someone as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.tr: phrase. 轻视某事；看不起某事；对某事持蔑视态度
words.ex: She tends to look down on people who don't have a college education.
words.ex_cn: 她往往看不起没有大学学历的人。
words.en: If you look down on someone or something, you consider them to be inferior or unimportant in comparison to yourself or to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: The children said they saw a ghost in the old house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们说他们在老房子里看到了一个鬼。
words.en: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that some people believe they can see or feel.

words.tr: phrase. 某事物的幽灵；某事物的残余或痕迹（常指已消失但仍隐约存在的影响或记忆）
words.ex: He still fears the ghost of his past mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然害怕过去错误的幽灵。
words.en: The memory or influence of something from the past that is still noticeable or affects the present.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.tr:
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍；
n. 三倍的数；三个一组；
adj. 三部分的；
words.ex: The company's profits tripled last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年的利润增长了三倍。
words.en: To triple something means to make it three times as much in size or number.

words.ex: He found uranium in the old rock sample.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧岩石样本中发现了铀。
words.en: A heavy, silvery-white metallic element, radioactive and toxic, used as a fuel in nuclear reactors and in the manufacture of nuclear weapons.

words.ex: He has a monopoly on selling ice cream in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座小镇上垄断了冰淇淋的销售。
words.en: If a company, person, or state has a monopoly on something such as an industry, they have complete control over it, so that it is impossible for others to become involved in it.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.ex: Two countries signed a treaty to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家签署了一项条约以停止战争。
words.en: A treaty is a formal agreement between two or more countries or groups, especially one that is written down and signed by their leaders.

words.tr: n. 微粒；大气尘；微粒物质；空气中微小颗粒（particulate 的复数形式）
words.ex: The air has many particulates after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 火灾之后，空气中有很多颗粒物。
words.en: Particulates are tiny particles of a substance, especially those that are produced by vehicles and are harmful when breathed in.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.tr:
n. 起义者；叛乱者；造反者
adj. 叛乱的；起义的
words.ex: The insurgent attacked the village at night.
words.ex_cn: 叛乱分子在夜里袭击了村庄。
words.en: An insurgent is a person who rises in active revolt against an established authority or government.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 模糊的；不确定的；无限期的
words.ex: He gave an indefinite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个不确定的答案。
words.en: If you describe something as indefinite, you mean that it has not been decided or defined clearly, or that it has no clear limit or end.

words.ex: A wisp of hay lay on the barn floor.
words.ex_cn: 干草堆上有一小捆干草。
words.en: A wisp is a small, thin, and often delicate piece or strand of something, such as smoke, hair, or cloud.

words.ex: Hitherto, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 迄今为止，没有人解决过这个问题。
words.en: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.

words.ex: The synthesis of ideas helped solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这些想法的综合帮助解决了问题。
words.en: The act of combining different ideas, influences, or objects into a new and coherent whole.

words.ex: The sheep graze on a high plateau.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在高高原上吃草。
words.en: A plateau is a large area of high and fairly flat land. It can also refer to a period during which there are no large changes.

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: The fusion of music and technology creates new sounds.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与技术的融合创造了新的声音。
words.en: The process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: The states formed a confederation to share power.
words.ex_cn: 这些州组成了一个联盟来分享权力。
words.en: A confederation is an organization which consists of a number of parties or groups united in an alliance.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.tr:
n. 闪耀；闪烁；小发光物
v. 闪耀；闪亮；流露（感情）
words.ex: The glitter of the stars lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星的闪耀照亮了夜空。
words.en: If something glitters, light comes from or is reflected off different parts of it.

words.tr:
adj. 辉煌的；成功的；盛大的；华丽的
v. 闪耀；闪亮；流露（感情）；“glitter”的现在分词
words.ex: The sky was filled with glittering stars.
words.ex_cn: 天空中满是闪闪发光的星星。
words.en: Something that is glittering shines brightly with little flashes of light.

words.ex: The lock has an intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁有复杂的结构。
words.en: You use intricate to describe something that has many small parts or details.

words.ex: He bought a new gadget to clean his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新的小器具来清洁厨房。
words.en: A gadget is a small device or machine with a particular purpose.

words.ex: The fringe of the forest is full of wildflowers.
words.ex_cn: 森林的边缘长满了野花。
words.en: The outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The combustion of wood produces heat and smoke.
words.ex_cn: 木材的燃烧会产生热量和烟雾。
words.en: Combustion is a chemical process in which a substance reacts with oxygen to give off heat and light.

words.ex: He works in a factory that makes semiconductors.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家生产半导体的工厂工作。
words.en: A semiconductor is a substance that can conduct electricity under some conditions but not others, making it a good medium for the control of electrical current.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.ex: The rotary switch turns on the light.
words.ex_cn: 旋转开关打开灯。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by rotation.

words.ex: The wind turbine spins to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机旋转以发电。
words.en: A turbine is a machine or engine which uses a stream of air, gas, water, or steam to turn a wheel and produce power.

words.tr:
adv. 顺时针方向地
adj. 顺时针方向的
words.ex: Turn the knob clockwise to open the jar.
words.ex_cn: 顺时针转动旋钮来打开罐子。
words.en: Moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock.

words.tr:
adj. 逆时针方向的
adv. 逆时针方向地
words.ex: The fan spins counterclockwise.
words.ex_cn: 风扇逆时针旋转。
words.en: In the opposite direction to the way in which the hands of a clock move.

words.ex: The Earth rotates around its axis.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕其轴旋转。
words.en: An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something, especially one that it turns around.

words.ex: This plan is viable and can be done with little money.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且用很少的钱就能完成。
words.en: If something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

words.tr:
n. 砍痕；伤痕；斜线号；削减
v. 砍；大幅度削减
words.ex: The tree has a deep slash on its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干上有一道深深的砍痕。
words.en: To cut something with a sharp object in a violent way; to reduce something by a large amount suddenly.

words.tr: v. 清除；“clear”的现在分词； n. 空旷地；
words.ex: They are clearing the leaves from the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在清除院子里的树叶。
words.en: A clearing is an open area in a forest where there are no trees or bushes.

words.ex: The river has a large outflow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这条河有大量的水流流入大海。
words.en: An outflow is an amount of something such as a liquid or gas that flows out from a place.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.tr: n. （单位面积或体积内的）生物量
words.ex: The farm uses biomass to make heat.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场用生物质来制造热量。
words.en: Biomass refers to the total mass of living organisms in a given area or volume, or organic material that comes from plants and animals, and it is a renewable energy source.

words.tr:
n. 后备人员；备用物品
adj. 备用的；应急的
words.ex: He is on standby for the emergency call.
words.ex_cn: 他正在待命，等待紧急电话。
words.en: A standby is something or someone that is ready to be used if needed, especially in an emergency.

words.ex: Open the window to ventilate the room.
words.ex_cn: 打开窗户给房间通风。
words.en: To ventilate means to cause fresh air to enter and move around a room, building, etc., or to express your opinions or feelings about something openly.

words.tr:
v. 弥漫；
adj. 分散的；
words.ex: Smoke began to diffuse through the room.
words.ex_cn: 烟开始弥漫在整个房间里。
words.en: If something such as knowledge or information is diffused, or if it diffuses, it is made known over a wide area or to a lot of people.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.ex: The factory uses automation to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用自动化来制造汽车。
words.en: The use of largely automatic equipment in a system of manufacturing or other production process.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.ex: The door opens on a metal hinge.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门装在一个金属枢纽上。
words.en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join two things together so that one of them can swing or move freely.

words.tr: v. （使）统一；（使）联合；（使）成一体；
words.ex: The two teams decided to unify their efforts.
words.ex_cn: 这两个团队决定统一他们的努力。
words.en: To unify means to make or become united, uniform, or whole.

words.tr: v. （使）统一；“unify”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 统一的；
words.ex: The two schools unified their programs last year.
words.ex_cn: 这两所学校去年统一了它们的课程。
words.en: Made into or caused to form a single unit or entity.

words.ex: The jet flies at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: relating to speeds that are faster than the speed of sound

words.tr: v. 开创；为（某人）举行就职典礼；为…举行开幕仪式
words.ex: The president will inaugurate the new hospital next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将于下周为新医院举行揭幕仪式。
words.en: If you inaugurate a new system, service, or project, you start it or introduce it officially.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.tr: phrase. 把某事考虑进去；将某因素纳入计算或计划中
words.ex: We need to factor the weather in when planning the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 我们计划野餐时需要把天气考虑进去。
words.en: To include something as a relevant element when making a calculation or decision.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 把某事考虑进去；将某因素纳入计算或计划中
words.ex: He factors in the weather when he plans his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在计划旅行时会考虑天气。
words.en: To consider or include something as a relevant element in a plan or calculation.

words.tr: phrase. 被预测会做某事；被预计会从事某事
words.ex: The population is projected to grow by 10% next year.
words.ex_cn: 预计人口明年将增长10%。
